Definition: a murmuring sound, i.e. a musical notation (probably similar to the modern affettuoso to indicate solemnity of movement); by implication, a machination
BiblicalUsage: 1) meditation, resounding music, musing; 1a) resounding music; 1b) meditation, plotting
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
